comp.chatParticipant.description: Intelligently compresses API specs and large code before sending your question to the LLM.
comp.conversationRecording.enabled.descr:
**(Beta)** Automatically record each conversation turn with AI agents to `.comp/history/`, so `session_recall` can restore it in later sessions. Off by default.

When on, **comP: Setup Agents** installs a Stop hook (`comp-daemon record-turn`) into `.claude/settings.local.json` for Claude Code. Records stay inside this workspace and are never sent anywhere.

Turning this off stops recording immediately but keeps the installed hook; run **comP: Remove Conversation Recording Hooks** (`comp.removeHistoryHooks`) to remove it.
comp.conversationRecording.claudeCode.de: **(Beta)** Record Claude Code conversations (Stop hook). Takes effect only while `comp.conversationRecording.enabled` is on.
comp.removeHistoryHooks.title: Remove Conversation Recording Hooks (Beta)
comp.ruleSharing.enabled.description:
**(Beta)** Share instruction files between AI agents. When on, `run_pipeline` also returns the sections of *other* agents' instruction files (`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.cursor/rules`, …) that matter for the task, and the new `check_rule_conflicts` tool lists pairs of sections that may contradict for the agent to judge. Off by default.

Only git-tracked files inside this workspace are read; user settings in your home directory (e.g. `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`) are never read. Sections handed out are saved once under `.comp/rules/` and referenced from the session record, so you can see later which rules an agent was given.
comp.indexWorkspaceFolders.description: In a multi-root workspace, writes the other folders into `workspace_folders` in the `.comp/config.json` of each folder that has a `.comp/` directory. Each folder's index then includes the other folders too, so an agent started in any folder can search every folder. Because each folder indexes everything, the index grows and indexing takes longer. Turn this off to empty the list.
comp.blockHiddenHomeFolders.description:
Refuses hidden folders of your home directory as additional roots (`additional_paths` / `workspace_folders`): folders starting with `.` such as `.ssh`, plus `AppData` and `Library`, and the files inside them. `AppData\Local\Temp` is allowed. This keeps a repository's `.comp/config.json` from reading your secrets. Workspace settings cannot change it.

This setting only applies to the daemon the extension starts. To turn it off for a daemon an agent (such as Claude Code) starts, add `COMP_ALLOW_HIDDEN_HOME_ROOTS=1` to `env` in that agent's MCP settings.
comp.useWorkspaceDaemonBuild.description:
For comP developers. Runs the daemon built in this workspace (`daemon/target/release/comp-daemon`, then `daemon/target/debug/`) instead of the one bundled with the extension, and writes that path into agent MCP settings. Off by default: the build may be older than the extension, and a cloned repository could put any executable at that path. Workspace settings cannot turn it on, but once on it applies to every folder you open — turn it on only while developing comP.

When the running daemon's version differs from the extension's, comP shows a warning.
